verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is explicitly a code-first background-jobs platform where tasks are 'plain async/await functions with no workflow DSL' (trigger-dev-docs-34), not a visual builder with drag-and-drop branching, conditions, filters, or parallel-path merging. No evidence pack item shows any visual canvas, branch/merge UI, or filter nodes; all control flow is done via TypeScript code and features like triggerAndWait, concurrency queues, and wait tokens, which are developer-code constructs, not ops-facing visual branching tools.
